/wmc price <item> <quality 1-6> <price> - set the buy price (0 = not bought)
/wmc enable|disable <item> - toggle whether an item is bought
/wmc sell <cocktail> <true|false> - whether merchants sell that cocktail
/wmc buy <cocktail> <true|false> - whether merchants buy that cocktail
/wmc mode [flat|quality] - view or switch the pricing mode
/wmc reload - re-read the config into memory
/wmc refresh [radius] - rebuild the trade table and refresh nearby merchants
(run it after changing prices, toggles or the blacklist - applies instantly, no restart)

or just the short name wine (the namespace is filled in). Tab completion works.
